description: Create a new lab test request and record results in GNU Health for patient 'Ana Betz'. Navigate to the Laboratory module (Lab Test Requests) and create a new lab test with: Patient 'Ana Betz', Test Type 'GLYCATED HEMOGLOBIN (HbA1c)', Health Professional 'Cordara, Cameron', Date of Test today. Save the request (it will be in Draft state). Then open the saved request, click 'Order' to change state to Ordered, then enter the test result: HbA1c value '7.2', unit '%'. Validate the results. Save the lab result.
